rules: a row is never scored on adjectives alone; each names the artifact or measurement that decides it
not-assessed is never counted as a pass and requires a recorded reason
evidence bound to a different candidate identity does not satisfy a row
comparator rows are scored only on the dimensions that comparator informs
motion lab is never globally scored against any comparator, and never against kerbal-space-program

rows.meets: every displayed quantity has a unit, every asserted relationship matches docs/SCIENCE_MODEL.md, and a science reviewer finds no high-severity defect
rows.below: any displayed value or claim contradicts the frozen model, or a high-severity science finding is open
rows.evidence: ML-03/ML-04 golden fixtures plus a science review record

rows.meets: each instrument names its quantity and unit, and its displayed value equals the authoritative value formatted by the frozen rounding rule
rows.below: an instrument shows an unlabelled, unitless, or ambiguously sourced value
rows.evidence: instrument-to-fixture test (ML-07) plus screenshot review

rows.meets: force arrows encode direction redundantly (arrowhead, text label and sign) and their magnitudes are consistent with authoritative net force
rows.below: direction or magnitude is conveyed by colour alone, or a visual force disagrees with authoritative net force
rows.evidence: ML-06 render test plus accessibility review

rows.meets: the learner can read position, velocity, acceleration, net force and elapsed time as text at any time during a trial
rows.below: any of those values is obtainable only from canvas geometry
rows.evidence: semantic DOM inspection plus the keyboard journey

rows.meets: a scripted click-everything strategy with no controlled trials fails every assessed mission, and a correct claim with no cited evidence is not accepted
rows.below: any assessed mission can be completed without producing and citing controlled evidence
rows.evidence: ML-10 state-machine tests plus the ML-13 guess-strategy test

rows.meets: at least one production scenario cannot be solved without reading a position-time or velocity-time graph as evidence
rows.below: every mission is solvable with numeric instruments alone
rows.evidence: scenario provenance graph flags plus the ML-11 journey test

rows.meets: the learner chooses which variable to change at Supported level and above, and the domain records the trial as a controlled comparison
rows.below: the game fixes every variable in every assessed comparison, or an uncontrolled trial counts as evidence
rows.evidence: ML-04 control-variable tests plus ML-13 scenario flags

rows.meets: changing net force or mass produces an immediately visible change in motion consistent with the authoritative trace
rows.below: the visible motion contradicts or lags the authoritative trace
rows.evidence: ML-06 render-versus-trace comparison

rows.meets: graphs use authoritative data, labelled axes and units, deterministic scales and an explicit origin, and provide a table equivalent
rows.below: a graph uses pixel geometry, unlabelled units, smoothed data, or a truncated axis that changes the interpretation
rows.evidence: ML-09 graph fixtures plus accessibility review

rows.meets: running and recording a second trial is reachable in a small bounded number of actions and no animation dwell blocks the next trial
rows.below: a trial cannot be repeated without leaving the mission or waiting on presentation timing
rows.evidence: interaction-count test plus state-transition latency evidence

rows.meets: retry is unlimited or clearly bounded, non-punitive, and creates a new trial identity without rewriting prior evidence
rows.below: retry loses evidence, punishes the learner, or silently overwrites trial history
rows.evidence: ML-04/ML-10 recovery tests

rows.meets: a committed action produces visible feedback within the recorded state-transition latency budget, excluding intentional dwell
rows.below: an action produces no feedback, or feedback is delayed beyond the recorded budget
rows.evidence: ML-14 latency evidence

rows.meets: after a run the learner can state what happened and why from the displayed evidence without external help
rows.below: the outcome is ambiguous or requires guessing which evidence matters
rows.evidence: target-age playtest record (ML-16) plus debrief review

rows.meets: production art is original, consistent and crisp at the tested viewports, with no placeholder art in released screens
rows.below: placeholder or inconsistent art ships, or art breaks at a tested viewport
rows.evidence: asset provenance plus screenshot review

rows.meets: a first-time learner identifies the mission objective without external instruction
rows.below: a first-time learner cannot state the objective from the brief and first screen
rows.evidence: target-age playtest record (ML-16)

rows.meets: architecture tests fail on any forbidden edge (science/domain importing React, Phaser, DOM, storage or network) and no authoritative value derives from renderer state
rows.below: a forbidden import exists, or a scientific value is derivable from pixels, sprites, collisions or animation
rows.evidence: architecture-boundary tests plus import lint

rows.meets: the same seed and configuration produce bit-identical authoritative evidence across runs and across renderer frame rates
rows.below: evidence differs between runs or between frame rates
rows.evidence: golden/property tests plus a replay test

rows.meets: the keyboard, screen-reader, reduced-motion, zoom and non-colour journeys each complete a representative mission and obtain all required evidence, with no open serious or critical automated violation
rows.below: any required journey cannot complete, or evidence is canvas-only, or a serious/critical violation is open
rows.evidence: ML-14 automated lane plus the ML-16 manual record

rows.meets: every ML-02 baseline metric is measured against the pinned baseline, material regressions are remediated or explicitly waived, and no new long task or memory trend is introduced
rows.below: a material regression is unaddressed, or a metric is claimed without measurement
rows.evidence: ML-14 evidence manifest

rows.meets: qualified flows show no unintended learner-data transmission and no prohibited runtime dependency, and no telemetry, LLM or account path exists
rows.below: any learner-data transmission, tracker, analytics SDK or account path exists
rows.evidence: network assertion plus dependency review

rows.meets: no comparator art, audio, name, character, text or layout ships; asset provenance is complete; the IP review finds no unresolved issue
rows.below: any comparator-derived content ships, or an asset has unknown provenance
rows.evidence: asset provenance manifest plus the ML-16 IP review

rows.meets: all four mission families are playable end-to-end with provenance manifests for every scenario and no unreviewed scenario in a production build
rows.below: a required family is missing, or a shipped scenario lacks provenance or review
rows.evidence: content validator plus the ML-13 inventory

rows.meets: debrief and mission copy are original and reviewed for a grades 6-8 reading level
rows.below: copy is copied, or its reading level is not reviewed
rows.evidence: reading-level review plus provenance
